tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The CISCO / VOLEX Power Cord (92-0125-250BK / 72-0460) is a high-performance Euro-plug to IEC C13 power cable made to strict international electrical standards.

It provides safe and stable power for Cisco networking hardware, data-center servers, and IT equipment.

Built by Volex, a trusted OEM manufacturer for Cisco and major global brands, this cable ensures exceptional durability, grounding safety, and efficient power transfer.


Key Features:

﻿

  • Brand: CISCO / VOLEX
  • Model Number: 92-0125-250BK / 72-0460
  • Cable Length: 2.5 Meters (Approx. 8.2 Feet)
  • Plug Type: Euro Plug (Type C, CEE 7/16 or CEE 7/7 depending on model)
  • Connector: IEC 60320 C13 (Female)
  • Voltage Rating: 250 VAC
  • Current Rating: 10 Amps
  • Color: Black
  • Certifications: CE, VDE, RoHS Compliant


Benefits:

  • Official CISCO/VOLEX OEM quality
  • Strong and flexible 2.5 m cord for professional rack use
  • Meets European safety and efficiency standards
  • Stable 10A power output for network and server devices
